html.en: Google Deepmind Research invited me to deliver a talk in 12th Nov, 2024 on one-step cross-modality generative models. Please check out the slides through A Path to Human-preferred One-step Text-to-image Generative Models .
html.zh: 受 Google DeepMind Research 邀请，于 2024 年 11 月 12 日作一步跨模态生成模型报告。幻灯片：A Path to Human-preferred One-step Text-to-image Generative Models。

html.en: The 18th X-AGI && China-R Conference invited me to deliver a talk in the multimodal panel, 18th, October 2025. The title of the talk is Multimodal Generation and Understanding: the Evolution of Data and Models .
html.zh: 受 18th X-AGI && China-R Conference 邀请，于 2025 年 10 月 18 日在多模态分论坛作报告。报告主题：Multimodal Generation and Understanding: the Evolution of Data and Models。

html.en: Few-step Diffusion Models meetup, and the Diffusion Circle, at the International Conference of Machine Learning, 14th July 2025, Vancouver.
html.zh: 2025 年 7 月 14 日，于温哥华国际机器学习大会期间参加 Few-step Diffusion Models Meetup 与 Diffusion Circle。

html.en: Research Talk @ Genmo AI, Online, 3rd Jan, 2025: RLHF for Text-to-image Models and Beyond.
html.zh: 2025 年 1 月 3 日，Genmo AI 线上研究报告：文生图模型中的 RLHF 及进一步探索。

html.en: Invited Talk @ Biomedical Engineering lab, Peking University, 25th Oct, 2024: Recent Progress on Diffusion Distillations.
html.zh: 2024 年 10 月 25 日，北京大学生物医学工程实验室受邀报告：扩散蒸馏的近期进展。

html.en: Invited Talk @ MAPLE lab, Westlake University, 20th Oct, 2024: Efficient Generative Models.
html.zh: 2024 年 10 月 20 日，西湖大学 MAPLE 实验室受邀报告：高效生成式模型。
